cluster_rationale: The same repetition reuses horizon/setback random streams across risk treatments; game-only clustering would not capture that dependence.
excluded_covariates: Human demographics and elicited risk preference are not defined for these LLM agents.
interpretation: Conditional associations in an endogenous repeated interaction; not causal effects.

persona_identification.remedy: Run every persona cell in one batch so they share source revision, decoding, and package versions; persona then varies inside a single protocol signature and its coefficient is estimable.

specification_rationale: The six nested specifications of Table 1 in the source paper. Comparing them shows whether a coefficient is stable or an artefact of one particular specification.
